description.value: Granville Kebab & Poutine is a Middle Eastern and Mediterranean restaurant on Vancouver's busy Granville Street, blending classic Canadian poutine with grilled beef and chicken kebabs in platters, wraps, and loaded poutine bowls. The fusion concept is a notable curiosity — baklava and kebab skewers share a menu with fries and gravy. Online ordering with a quick pickup window makes it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the downtown entertainment district.
